section_summary.extract_value: This section contains declarations regarding ethical compliance: the authors declare no conflict of interest, ethical approval was obtained in accordance with institutional and national standards and the Helsinki Declaration, and informed consent was obtained from all patients. The section does not report any study-level details such as sample size, country, measures, or results.
section_summary.evidence_source: Conflict of interest Authors Joana Marta-Simões and Cláudia Ferreira  declare that they have no conflict of interest. Ethical approval All procedures followed were in accordance with the  ethical standards of the responsible committee on human experimentation (institutional and national) and with the Helsinki Declaration of  1975, as revised in 2000. Informed consent Informed consent was obtained from all patients for  being included in the study.
